_about: Public-domain William Edwin Boardman (1810-1886), Presbyterian evangelist whose Higher Christian Life (1858) fed the holiness and Keswick movements, for the Word Hoard: The Higher Christian Life (1859 printing), He that Overcometh (1869), Faith Work under Dr. Cullis (1874) and In the Power of the Spirit (1876). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 67 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
